name: gpt-video
description: Codex video toolkit with local video evidence (Watch) and approval-based skill learning (Learn).

interface.shortDescription: Watch videos and learn reusable skills with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Watch turns video into timestamped transcript and image evidence for Codex. Learn turns tutorial evidence into reusable Agent Skills, requiring review before installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $watch to inspect this video locally and explain key moments.
Use $learn to turn this tutorial into a reusable skill; show the complete draft before installation.
